title: From Atomic Evidence to Logical Composition: Structured Compositional Reasoning over Compound Answer Options
abstract: arXiv:2608.12836v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models often fail when answer options require combining atomic judgments under explicit logical operators, even when they judge the individual atoms correctly. We study compound options connected by AND, OR, and NEITHER/NOR, introducing a framework that decomposes each option into atomic answers and scores contrastive hypotheses about each one, so the model never sees a compound option. An operator-constrained integer linear program then composes the calibrated scores into a single prediction. We evaluate on LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA and introduce LOGICAL-SATA, a reading-comprehension benchmark derived from SATA-Bench. Our framework improves Macro-F1 from 48.3 to 77.0 on the human-validated LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA split and from 47.0 to 75.6 on LOGICAL-SATA, with the largest gains on NEITHER/NOR.

translated_title: 从原子证据到逻辑组合：复合答案选项的结构化组合推理
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在答案选项需要结合逻辑运算符下的原子判断时常常失败，即使它们能正确判断单个原子。我们研究了由AND、OR和NEITHER/NOR连接的复合选项，引入了一个框架，将每个选项分解为原子答案，并对每个原子的对比假设进行评分，这样模型就永远不会看到复合选项。一个受运算符约束的整数线性规划随后将校准后的分数组合成单一预测。我们在LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA上进行了评估，并引入了LOGICAL-SATA，这是一个源自SATA-Bench的阅读理解基准。我们的框架在人工验证的LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA分割上将Macro-F1从48.3提高到77.0，在LOGICAL-SATA上从47.0提高到75.6，其中NEITHER/NOR的收益最大。
tldr: 提出了一种将复合答案选项分解为原子判断并利用整数线性规划组合分数的方法，显著提升了大型语言模型在逻辑组合推理任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: A framework that decomposes compound answer options into atomic judgments and uses integer linear programming to compose scores, significantly improving LLM performance on logical compositional reasoning tasks.
